note: Most tracks are the urban nations of Recife (baque virado), recorded by the groups themselves; the rural baque solto form comes from Aliança, Carpina, Mestre Salustiano and Siba. Claudionor Germano sings composed carnival maracatus in the older radio-song style.

size.basis: No source counts recordings. English Wikipedia gives around 20 nações in Recife and Olinda and dozens of rural groups; the Inventário Sonoro compilation alone has 19 nações. Albums found are mostly self-released CDs of 13-15 loas per group (Estrela Brilhante 2002, Leão Coroado 2004, Porto Rico 2004, Encanto da Alegria, Estrela Brilhante de Igarassu 2025), stage groups (Nação Pernambuco 1993, two LPs), rural-maracatu compilations (Maracatu Atômico, recorded 2000) and authors working from the tradition (Siba, Mestre Salustiano), plus composed carnival maracatus by Recife songwriters sung on record since the radio era, and hundreds of groups abroad. An insider's essential list is about 40 loas and performances.
